title: Snails with mint

healthBenefits.title: Lean Protein Source
healthBenefits.text: Snails are low in fat and high in protein, supporting muscle maintenance and repair.

healthBenefits.title: Rich in Iron
healthBenefits.text: Snails provide significant iron content, helping prevent anemia and support oxygen transport in the blood.

healthBenefits.title: Digestive Aid
healthBenefits.text: Mint leaves soothe the digestive tract and can help reduce bloating and indigestion.

healthBenefits.title: Immune Support
healthBenefits.text: Garlic contains allicin, a compound with antimicrobial and immune-boosting properties.

healthBenefits.title: Vitamin C Boost
healthBenefits.text: Lemon adds vitamin C, which supports immune function and enhances iron absorption from the snails.

healthBenefits.title: Heart-Healthy Fats
healthBenefits.text: Extra virgin olive oil provides monounsaturated fats that support cardiovascular health.

_ingredientsText:
1 Kg of snails (land snails)
 10 mint leaves
 1 clove of garlic, chopped
 1 lemon
 2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
 salt
_preparationText:
1 - chiocciole in natura
2 - preparate per la cottura
3 - presentazione finale con foglioline di menta
